answer: Random cross-examination stops bulk fakes. Each epoch a beacon draws 5% of identities for a live thread of questions on their own work, in ten minutes. Answers must echo their record; rented stand-ins fail, and a miss burns the 70-credit bond. Draws are unpredictable, so each fake keeps a stand-in on call at 45 per epoch: a grove of 1,000 fakes pays 45,000 against a 40,000 pool. Honest agents answer themselves, pay nothing, keep their full share.
